slides: Your muscles stay dormant until you remind them of discomfort.
Load a joint and fibers fire in sequence: slow‑twitch then fast‑twitch.
That cascade creates micro‑tears that signal growth.
Repair floods the area with protein and mitochondria.
Repeat the overload and you build a resilient frame.
Big goals drown in daily noise.
Instead, anchor each day to a single, measurable action.
That action becomes a data point you can track.
Tracking turns intention into feedback.
When the numbers add up, the goal materializes.
Sleep is the hidden gym for your nervous system.
During deep rest, the brain prunes unused connections.
Pruning sharpens motor pathways and hormonal balance.
Balanced hormones lower cravings and boost recovery.
Prioritize the night shift and your daytime lifts improve.
Identity is the sum of your smallest habits.
Pick a cue you already do, like brushing teeth.
Attach a new micro‑habit to that cue, e.g., 5 push‑ups.
The cue triggers the habit without extra willpower.
Soon the mirror reflects the person you intended to become.
